visual.name: plumeTreemap
visual.description: Treemap with the Plume Studio look: nested hierarchy of 1 to 6 levels with group headers and borders, squarified, binary or alternating tiling, zoom into a group with breadcrumb, labels that grow with the tile and wrap, sort, colors by category, single or gradient; premium: play axis with animated, stable tiles, color by tile, diverging or threshold colors, shares in labels, Voronoi treemap inside a shape, stock-market change map, Top N + Others, images in tiles and small multiples.
